verdict.rationale: Claude Design documents export to PPTX, PDF, and HTML, plus SVG export (with some caveats around animation stripping), but there is no evidence of per-layer export presets, multiple scale factors, or slice-based exports typical of production asset pipelines. missing for 10: PNG export, per-layer export presets, scale/density variants (1x/2x/3x), slice tool for exporting selected regions, batch/preset export workflow.
